transcript.note: Round 1 — one single off-segment left (7 凱旋/前鎮之星 (2,1) → 2 小港 (7,0), dx=5 dy=-1), 20/21 already H/V. Reasoning: the whole R line is already one perfectly straight column at col 2 (都會公園 (2,12) → 油廠國小 (2,8) → 凹子底 (2,5) → 美麗島 (2,3) → 凱旋 (2,1)); 小港 is the only station of that line hanging off it. Making the segment H is structurally impossible: 凱旋 is a frozen square vertex of the 高雄環狀輕軌 ring, and the ring's green fold point shape-g0 sits at (4,1), due east of 凱旋 on row 1 — any horizontal 凱旋→小港 segment would swallow it (occlusion rule ③b). Rotating 小港 up to a NE 45° cell is blocked by the quadrant rule (小港 must stay south of 凱旋), and the only reachable SE 45° cell (3,0) still leaves hv at 20. So the one move that reaches full alignment is to pull 小港 straight down to (2,0), extending the R line's existing column by one cell — the same choice the official 高雄捷運 diagram makes (red line drawn as a single vertical). Winding order at the degree-4 hub 凱旋 is preserved: the bearing of 小港 goes from -11° to -90°, still ahead of shape-g0 (0°), 美麗島 (90°) and 軟體園區 (180°) in the same cyclic sequence; the quadrant rule allows it because dx collapses to 0 (sign 0 is free) and 小港 stays south. Cost is a 5-cell westward drift for one degree-1 terminus, paid for by the last off-segment becoming vertical: hv 20/21 → 21/21.
